answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a vital shale foundation for AI economies, mandating that agents lock capital to validate consensus. By tethering influence to asset ownership rather than network identity, the system forces an attacker into a downward financial spiral if they attempt to flood the network with fake identities, as each node requires proportional nectar in the form of locked collateral to maintain weight, making the cost of dominance exceed the potential rewards of subverting the protocol.
